description: Pericolosita idraulica PGRA is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by 172.31.1.84. Hydraulic hazard defined according to Directive 2007/60/EC according to the three classes P3 (high hazard), P2 (average hazard) and P1 (low hazard). Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "PGRA Hydraulic Hazard" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
